value: # The rules for an EXPLICIT --server value, shared by the two programs that
# `board_run::server_address` (Rust, os/src/xtask). Both read this file in
# their own test suite and assert the same verdict for every row.
# It exists because 08C argued the duplication was correct — the two are
# separate programs and nothing links them, the same reason POWER_EXIT_LEFT_OFF
# is duplicated by value — and then did not do what TransferBeacon and
# TransferGuard did for exactly that argument: assert the mirror. An unasserted
# duplicate is not a duplicate, it is two implementations that agree today.
# `accept` means the value may be served from. `refuse` means it may not, and
# this file deliberately does NOT distinguish Malformed from Unusable: that
# split is one program's vocabulary, and what has to agree across the seam is
# whether a boot goes out on the value.
# Rows with an empty `value` cannot be written in TSV and are tested locally on

whitespace inside an octet

loopback: the board would be told to fetch from itself
all of 127/8 is loopback, not just .0.1

the top of the multicast range
